title: 第12章 死剑不认主第11章 换签
lines: ：沈霜喝下第一碗药时，手还是抖的。
像怕喝快了，下一碗就没了。
沈照夜坐在门边，看着瓦檐下的雨线。
西偏院的屋子旧，雨一大，屋角就滴水。周野拿了一个缺口陶盆放在地上，水一滴一滴落进去，响得人心烦。
周野蹲在陶盆旁边，终于忍不住开口。
“薛承是剑士境，你现在这副样子，真上台？”
沈照夜若说伤重，韩松一定能找出三条规矩，证明杂役弟子无故误场，视作自弃资格。
那只手从第一轮下台后就一直没有自然垂下。
沈霜握着药碗，指尖发白。
“每次你碰照夜，回来都疼得睡不着。那夜从黑石矿栈回来，你咬着布条，我都听见了。”
沈霜眼眶有些红，却没有哭。
“可是哥，死人的剑，真会帮活人吗？”
他想起废剑冢里的第一声剑鸣。
它们告诉他败处，告诉他破绽，也一次次把疼痛和怨气压进他的骨头里。
他只知道，明日不上台，沈霜这包药也会变成一张废纸。
content_en:
: When Shen Shuang drank the first bowl of medicine, her hands were still shaking.
The medicine is very bitter.
But she drank slowly.
It’s like I’m afraid that if I drink too fast, the next bowl will be gone.
Shen Zhaoye sat by the door and looked at the lines of rain under the eaves.
The house in the west courtyard is old. When it rains heavily, water drips from the corner of the house. Zhou Ye took a chipped pottery basin and placed it on the ground. Water dripped into it, making the sound disturbing.
"The second game tomorrow."
Zhou Ye squatted beside the pottery basin and finally couldn't help but speak.
"Xue Cheng is a swordsman. How can you really take the stage like this?"
Shen Zhaoye didn't look back.
"No, the medicine supply is gone."
"You can drag."
"Han Song won't let me delay."
Zhou Ye choked.
This is true.
If Shen Zhaoye said that he was seriously injured, Han Song would definitely be able to find three rules to prove that the handyman disciple's absence from the show without any reason would be regarded as giving up his qualifications.
Shen Shuang put down the medicine bowl.
"Brother."
Her voice was soft.
Shen Zhaoye turned his head.
Shen Shuang looked at his right arm.
That hand has not been hanging naturally since he stepped down in the first round.
He hid it well.
But Shen Shuang could see it.
"Don't go looking for a more dangerous sword."
The room fell silent.
Zhou Ye looked at Shen Zhaoye.
Shen Zhaoye did not deny it.
Shen Shuang held the medicine bowl, her fingertips turning white.
"Every time you touch Zhao Ye, you come back from the pain so much that you can't sleep. That night when you came back from the Black Stone Mine, I heard you biting the strip of cloth."
Shen Zhaoye was silent for a moment.
"Tomorrow it's Xue Cheng."
"I know."
"He has entered the swordsman realm."
"I know too."
Shen Shuang's eyes were a little red, but she didn't cry.
"But brother, can a dead man's sword really help the living?"
This sentence made Shen Zhaoye pause.
He remembered the first sword sound in the Tomb of Wasted Swords.
Thinking of the remnants of those defeated swords.
They told him of his failures, told him of his flaws, and pressed pain and resentment into his bones again and again.
Will the Death Sword help the living?
He doesn't know.
He only knew that if he didn't go on stage tomorrow, Shen Shuang's package of medicine would become a piece of waste paper.
Shen Zhaoye got up.
title_en: Chapter 12 The Death Sword Disowns its Master Chapter 11 Changing Lots
